description: Content pages and utility pages: gallery/page.tsx, blogs/page.tsx, not-found.tsx, error.tsx, loading.tsx. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 in terms of logic, but depends on FEAT-001 for the CSS tokens. These are the final pages needed to complete the full site redesign. The gallery preserves all lightbox logic verbatim; blogs preserves all filter/search logic verbatim.
steps: 1. Edit src/app/gallery/page.tsx: PRESERVE VERBATIM: GalleryImage interface, GALLERY_IMAGES array (all 20 s1-s20 paths), SACRED_FILMS array, Lightbox component (all keyboard event handlers, touch swipe handlers, body.style.overflow management), GalleryCard component (all hover effects, gold shimmer sweep, corner accents — these are already gold-based), FilmCard component, openLightbox/closeLightbox/nextImage/prevImage callbacks, activeTab useState, filteredImages computation. Replace only background colors: hero bg-background (remove hardcoded bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1a1410] via-charcoal); decorative rings border-gold/[0.08] (already close, keep as-is or adjust to border-gold/10); hero glow bg-saffron/[0.04]→bg-gold/10. Tab buttons: active = bg-gold text-background (replace bg-maroon), inactive = bg-secondary text-text/90 hover:bg-gold/20 (replace bg-charcoal). Lightbox backdrop: bg-background/95 (replace bg-[#0d0a08]/95). Close/nav buttons: bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 (keep). Image border: border-gold/20 (keep). h1 'Sacred Moments' text-text (replace text-white hardcode). Subtitle text-muted. Decorative diamond bg-gold (already is). Camera icon text-gold.

2. Edit src/app/blogs/page.tsx: PRESERVE VERBATIM: all useState (selectedCategory, searchQuery), useMemo filteredPosts, featured/regularPosts split, BLOG_POSTS/BLOG_CATEGORIES imports. Hero: bg-background (remove from-ivory via-ivory-dark). h1 text-gold (replace text-maroon). Subtitle text-muted. Search input bg-secondary border-secondary focus:ring-gold. Decorative editorial lines border-gold/5 (replace border-maroon/5). Featured badge bg-gold text-background (replace bg-saffron text-charcoal). Featured article image placeholder gradient from-primary via-secondary to-gold/10. Category label text-gold (replace text-saffron-dark). Article title text-gold hover:text-gold-light (replace text-maroon hover:text-maroon-light). Category tag on card: bg-secondary/90 backdrop-blur text-gold (replace bg-white/90 text-maroon). Article cards bg-secondary border-secondary hover:border-gold/20 (replace bg-white border-ivory-dark). Author avatar bg-gold/10 (replace bg-maroon/10). Read time/date text-muted. Section header 'Latest Articles' text-gold. Count text-muted. Category filter buttons (if present): active bg-gold text-background, inactive bg-secondary. CTA section bg-primary (replace bg-maroon). CTA heading text-text, body text-text/70. BookOpen icon text-gold.

3. Edit src/app/not-found.tsx: icon container bg-gold/10. 404 text inside: text-gold font-serif. h1 text-gold. Body text text-muted. Background: body uses bg-background from layout. Primary button: use Button variant='gold'. Secondary button: Button variant='secondary'. Import Button from @/components/ui/button. Keep motion.div animation. Keep Home and ArrowLeft lucide imports.

4. Edit src/app/error.tsx: icon container bg-gold/10 (replace bg-saffron/20). AlertTriangle: text-gold (replace text-saffron-dark). h2: text-gold (replace text-maroon). Body text: text-muted. Button variant='gold' (replace variant='primary'). Keep useEffect error logging. Keep reset prop. Background inherits bg-background from layout.

5. Edit src/app/loading.tsx: spinner border class: 'border-gold/20 border-t-gold' (replace 'border-maroon/20 border-t-maroon'). Text: text-muted (replace text-charcoal-light). Wrapper: min-h-[60vh] flex items-center justify-center (keep). No background needed (inherits from layout). Keep aria-label.

6. Final scan: search all modified files for any remaining hardcoded hex colors from the old palette (#7B1E3A maroon, #F2A93B saffron, #FFF8F0 ivory, #2E2A26 charcoal) or any Tailwind classes bg-maroon, text-maroon, text-saffron, bg-ivory, text-charcoal, border-ivory that may have been missed. Fix any found.
7. Run final build to confirm all 4 FEATs integrate cleanly. Confirm: no TypeScript errors, no missing imports, no broken dynamic routes.
